headline: Approved administrator contract template for principals and assistant principals after changes to vacation and evaluation language.
summary: Legal counsel Bill Conley presented the template contract, which was revised to move vacation to an accrual system and to add evaluation language for non-principals. The committee also amended its policy on School Committee agenda requests, moving December dates to November.
decisions: Approved the May 18, 2026 meeting minutes, with two members abstaining.
Approved the administrator contract template for principals and assistant principals unanimously.
Approved amendments to the School Committee agenda requests policy BEDB unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to approve: Kimberly Grant Second: Lee Rabbitt Yea: all Abstain: Suzette Wordell, Christina DiPrete Motion carries.
Motion to approve the administrator template for principals and assistant principals: Kimberly Grant Second: Lee Rabbitt Yea: all Motion carries unanimously.
